description: This script is used for managing a local Kubernetes cluster using kind, including creation and deletion, with auto-detection of container engines (docker or podman). It handles argument parsing, provider detection, prerequisite checks, cluster lifecycle commands, and cluster status verification.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints error messages in red and exits.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container engine (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container engine responds to commands.

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects whether docker or podman is installed and responsive.
